deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/Attachment_1_-_Salient_Characteristics_-_Spectrum_Analyzer.pdf ===== Salient Characteristics of the Requirement Salient characteristics refer to speciﬁc features or characteristics that are important or distinctive. In the context of attachments or documents, salient characteristics may include details such as product speciﬁcations, interoperability, or performance requirements. Description of Needs A Radio Frequency/Spectrum monitoring system required must be a comprehensive solution suitable for both static and mobile operations. The core of the system shall be a portable receiver with a frequency range enough to cover a majority of the RF Spectrum of interest, ideally 8KHz to 8GHz, equipped with software capabilities for panoramic spectrum scanning, direction ﬁnding, and data recording. To support this receiver, the system must include a versatile antenna package consisting of: a set of handheld, interchangeable directional antennas covering appropriate frequency ranges; and a vehicle-mountable, omni-d

of: a set of handheld, interchangeable directional antennas covering appropriate frequency ranges; and a vehicle-mountable, omni-directional antenna for mobile direction ﬁnding. Control and analysis will be performed via a ruggedized laptop or tablet, loaded with software that provides an integrated suite for real-time signal analysis, data collection, and remote operation of the receiver. The entire system must be contained in durable transit cases and include a complete power solution with a rechargeable battery, a charging station, and a DC vehicle power adapter to ensure full operational capability in the ﬁeld.
